coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit zapfast.install due to an API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for transient API errors (e.g., HTTP 400/500) during file audits to prevent unnecessary inconclusive verdicts.
